Hexify Readability Refactor Plan

Source: REFACTOR_PLAN.md

Status: COMPLETED (2024-12-12)

All 7383 tests pass after refactoring.

Overview

Refactored codebase to reduce nesting depth, extract helper functions, and improve readability.

Completed Changes

Phase 1: hex_map.R - Critical (Highest Impact) ✓

1.1 Extracted shared utilities

1.2 Flattened color scale logic

1.3 Extracted hexify_heatmap() helpers (341 lines → ~100 lines main + helpers)

Phase 2: snyder_inverse.cpp - High Priority ✓

Phase 3: hex_assign.R - Medium Priority ✓

Phase 4: core_icosa.cpp - Medium Priority ✓

Phase 5: tri_to_q2di.cpp - Documentation ✓

Summary of Improvements

File Before After Improvement
hex_map.R:hexify_heatmap 341 lines, 5+ nesting ~100 lines main, 2 nesting 70% reduction in main function
snyder_inverse.cpp Inline Newton loop Extracted solver with struct Clear convergence semantics
hex_assign.R 12 sequential transforms 4 focused helpers Structured pipeline
core_icosa.cpp Dense trig expressions Named intermediates Self-documenting math
tri_to_q2di.cpp Minimal header ASCII diagrams Visual documentation

  • All 7383 tests pass
